children: Despite making 3Q noisier, EQB's acquisition of PC Financial should improve forward outlook, according to Paul Holden of CIBC, but some question marks still loom. The analyst says that the transaction puts EQB in an "improved competitive position," enhancing fee income and direct demand deposit growth potential. However, Holden cautions that uncertainty remains over credit losses on mortgages. He says that impaired provisions for credit losses may remain elevated this year and next, after having increased "across residential mortgages, commercial mortgages and equipment finance." He maintains an outperformer rating on the stock but lowers the price target to C$154 from C$165. Shares are down 1.7% to C$126.57. (adriano.marchese@wsj.com)
